{{Quote|Alpha 2, intercept E/S Ayalam before they get to TRN Epsilon|Imperial|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''Ayalam''' was an [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] that was used by the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] during the [[Sepan Civil War]]. During the [[First Battle of the Sepan system]] the Escort Shuttle was dispatched in an attempt to stop a seizure of [[Modular conveyor]] group [[Asbo]], which contained war supplies including [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] munitions, likely sold by [[Admiral]] [[Harkov]] who ironically lead the seizure. The Escort shuttle attempted to destroy [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transport]] group [[Epsilon (disambiguation)|Epsilon]] but was shot down by Imperial forces.
